task: Phase 04 Identity & RBAC Core: BaseRole STUDENT|TEACHER + isSystemAdmin + authzVersion + RoleChangeLog, RS256 JWT with JWKS (claims sub,sid,roles,email_verified,av), libs/auth-jwt stateless guards and fixed permission catalog replacing DB-querying guards in all services, service tokens via client_credentials with @ServiceOnly, role-change flow with last-admin protection and auth.user.authz_changed outbox event, finance teacher wallet provisioning
acceptanceCriteria: yarn typecheck, build:all and test exit 0; auth, finance and admin e2e pass
no AuthGuard/AdminGuard/OptionalAuthGuard/JWT_SECRET left in apps or libs (except GoogleAuthGuard/AuthStrictThrottlerGuard)
libs/auth-jwt has no userSession or prisma usage
tokens are RS256 with kid, verified via JWKS, carry sub, sid, roles, email_verified and av; refresh reloads role and authzVersion inside a transaction
permission catalog matches the plan: STUDENT learning-only, TEACHER content/AI/wallet incl word_family:save, SYSTEM_ADMIN admin-only with no wildcard
guards deny by default; @Public, @Authenticated (denies unverified) and @AllowUnverified behave as specified; ws contexts are skipped
every @GrpcMethod declares a guard; a gRPC call without metadata to finance UpdateBalance returns UNAUTHENTICATED
service tokens are issued via client_credentials and accepted only from allowlisted callers
role changes: self-change and last SYSTEM_ADMIN removal blocked, serialized, RoleChangeLog written, authzVersion bumped, auth.user.authz_changed emitted via outbox
register creates STUDENT with no subscription; /auth/me returns roles, permissions and isSystemAdmin with no isAdmin key, and a new STUDENT has no wallet
promoting to TEACHER provisions exactly one wallet with 20 credits idempotently
demotion keeps content and ownership untouched
blastRadius: every authenticated HTTP route in all services
login, refresh, OAuth and register flows
admin bootstrap and admin user management
contracts: JWT algorithm and claims change (HS256 -> RS256 + JWKS)
/auth/me response shape (roles, permissions, isSystemAdmin; isAdmin removed)
gRPC calls now require authorization metadata
